#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

constexpr long long MOD1=998244353, MOD2=1000000007;

long long counter=0, limit_n, low_value, answer=0, power[8];
vector<int> digits[7];

void generate_numbers(int digit, int x)
{
    int temp=(counter+MOD1-x)%MOD1;
    digits[digit].push_back(temp);
    low_value=(low_value+temp)%MOD2;
    counter++;
    if(digit<6)
    {
        for(int i=0;i<10;i++) generate_numbers(digit+1,x*10+i);
    }
}

void process_numbers(int digit, long long x)
{
    if(x>limit_n) return;
    int i;
    if(x*power[6]+power[6]-1<=limit_n && x*power[7]>limit_n)
    {
        for(i=0;i<=6;i++)
        {
            long long delta=(counter+(MOD1-power[i])*x)%MOD1;
            answer=(answer+(delta+MOD2-MOD1)*power[i]+MOD1*(lower_bound(digits[i].begin(),digits[i].end(),MOD1-delta)-digits[i].begin()))%MOD2;
        }
        answer=(answer+low_value)%MOD2;
        counter+=1111111;
        return;
    }
    answer=(answer+(counter+MOD1-x%MOD1)%MOD1)%MOD2;
    counter++;
    for(i=digit?0:1;i<10;i++) process_numbers(digit+1,x*10+i);
}

int main()
{
    int i;
    power[0]=1;
    for(i=1;i<=7;i++) power[i]=power[i-1]*10;
    generate_numbers(0,0);
    for(i=1;i<=6;i++) sort(digits[i].begin(),digits[i].end());
    cin>>limit_n;
    counter=0;
    process_numbers(0,0);
    cout<<answer<<endl;
    return 0;
}
